name: LetterGrid
storyline: Two players face off on a battlefield of letters, competing to conquer territory and reach the opponent’s border. Find words by connecting adjacent letters, expand your territory across the grid, and block your opponent’s path. Every word is a move, and every move can shift the balance of the battle. Outsmart your opponent and be the first to invade their border.
summary:
LetterGrid is a multiplayer strategy word game in which players find words on a grid of letters while competing for control of the board.

The game features two main multiplayer modes. In Invasion mode, players build chains of words across the board with the goal of reaching and invading their opponent's border. In Territory mode, players compete to capture and control more territory than their opponent.

LetterGrid combines word-building with strategic board play, requiring players to consider both the words they can create and how each move affects their position on the board.

In addition to multiplayer matches, LetterGrid features daily word puzzles, leaderboards, player statistics, and support for 11 languages.
